fixes: A quantity is a usable quantity only when it is a JSON integer of 0 or more, so text, decimals, booleans and null now receive malformed_quantity.
Added the missing outside_period exception for a read whose day lies in no billing period of its account.
Added the missing replaced_estimate exception for an estimate whose day already has an accepted measured read.
duplicate_read now compares the estimated flag as well and only fires against an earlier read that was itself accepted.
The exception list is sorted by read_id alone; it used to be sorted by account first.
Reads now carry their estimated and cumulative flags, and billed_quantities bills a cumulative read as the rise over the previous accepted cumulative read of its meter.
A meter can hold several active windows for one account, so inactive_meter looks at every row of accounts.csv for the pair.
